html:
Nature's Seed — March 2026 Board Update

_Updated: April 13, 2026 (final March numbers)_

---

Overview

March was a breakout month. $513K revenue (+14.2% YoY, +18.5% vs budget) — the first month in 2026 to beat both prior year and plan. Spring demand arrived in force during the final week, pushing daily revenue above $20K and lifting the month well past the $433K target. Every channel contributed: DTC at $475K, Amazon at $31K (+281% MoM), and Walmart at $8K.

April is tracking strong. Through April 12: $197K revenue at $16.4K/day — on pace for ~$493K, well above the $399K budget.

Key Metrics

| Metric | March 2026 | vs Budget | vs Prior Year |

|---|---|---|---|

| Revenue | $513,441 | +18.5% ($433K target) | +14.2% |

| Orders | 4,031 | — | — |

| AOV | $127.38 | — | — |

| Ad Spend | $105,948 | +$33K over plan | — |

| MER (Revenue / Ad Spend) | 4.85x | — | — |

| Gross Margin | ~69% est. | — | — |

| Est. New Customers | ~3,100 | — | — |

EBITDA Bridge

| Driver | Impact | Commentary |

|---|---|---|

| Revenue vs Budget | +$80K | Late-March surge — final week averaged $20K+/day |

| COGS vs Budget | TBD | Favorable margin mix expected (lawn and clover leading) |

| Ad Spend vs Budget | -$33K | Spent $106K vs ~$73K budget — funded by revenue upside |

| Shipping vs Budget | TBD | Structural gap between collected and actual freight under review |

Ad spend ran $33K over plan, but the incremental spend was profitable: MER held at 4.85x and revenue beat budget by $80K. March EBITDA will be finalized once finance actuals close.

Channel Performance

| Channel | March | vs Feb | vs LY | Share |

|---|---|---|---|---|

| DTC (naturesseed.com) | $474,695 | +165% | +13% est. | 92% |

| Amazon | $30,810 | +281% | New channel | 6% |

| Walmart | $7,937 | +1,519% | New channel | 2% |

Amazon grew from $8K to $31K in a single month — nearly 4x — with zero incremental ad spend. Walmart is steady at ~$8K, also with no paid advertising. Marketplaces now represent 8% of total revenue, up from 4.6% in February.

Menards retail opportunity: A buyer reached out for product submission. A 77-SKU catalog with validated delivered pricing has been prepared and is ready to submit. This could open 300+ retail store doors across the Midwest.

Wins

  • Best March in company history — first 2026 month to beat both prior year and budget
  • Amazon nearly 4x'd in one month ($8K to $31K) with no ad spend
  • Revenue acceleration in the final week ($20K+/day vs $15K average in weeks 1-3)
  • Menards wholesale inquiry received — catalog ready for submission
  • 1,053 verified product reviews now syndicating to Google Shopping ads (star ratings visible to shoppers)
  • Automated post-purchase review collection deployed — building the review pipeline for sustained social proof

Watch Items

  • Ad spend efficiency at scale: $106K vs ~$73K budget. MER at 4.85x is healthy but below February's 5.04x. As we push spend higher in peak season, efficiency must be monitored closely.
  • YTD still trailing prior year: $785K vs $841K (-6.5%). March closed the gap significantly (was -11%), but we need April to continue the trend to finish Q2 ahead of LY.
  • Shipping margin gap: Collected shipping revenue vs actual freight cost has a structural spread. Analysis underway to quantify the gap and identify pricing or carrier changes.
  • Shopper Approved integration: Product review collection was disconnected since August 2025. Reconnection is in progress — critical for maintaining review volume on Google Shopping.

What Drove the March Growth

March surged to $513K — up 173% from February's $188K and 14.2% above March 2025's $450K. Growth came from both operational improvements and the seasonal ramp arriving.

| Growth Driver | Impact | Evidence |

|---|---|---|

| Spring demand (seasonality) | Primary driver | Late Feb to Mar ramp consistent with 2025 pattern, delayed ~2 weeks |

| Scaled Google Ads profitably | $102K spend at 4.85x MER | Increased budget while maintaining efficiency across Shopping and Broad campaigns |

| New website (launched Q1) | Conversion rate multiplier | Higher-converting site compounds every dollar of traffic spend |

| Amazon scaling organically | +$23K MoM | $31K with zero incremental ad spend — channel building its own momentum |

| Walmart (new channel) | $7.9K incremental | Second full month, zero advertising cost, 100% additive revenue |

| Email marketing program | Engagement + repeat purchases | 55 campaigns deployed across March-May to sustain customer lifecycle |

The compounding effect is clear. Higher ad budget on a better-converting site, combined with two marketplace channels that did not exist last year, delivered the best March in company history.

Initiatives (March-April)

1. Ad campaign optimization — Keyword coverage expanded 125% (67 to 150 keywords), improving impression share and reach across Google Shopping and Search

2. Product review syndication to Google Shopping — 1,053 verified reviews now display as star ratings on Shopping ads, improving click-through rates

3. Amazon FBA inventory separation + demand forecasting — Ensures stock availability as the channel scales toward $30K+/month

4. Menards wholesale catalog — 77 SKUs with validated delivered pricing, ready for buyer submission across 300+ store locations

5. Post-purchase review collection — Automated flow targeting all 2026 customers, including a backfill campaign for customers who were never asked

6. Finance actuals integration — Dashboard now uses real P&L data for closed months, improving reporting accuracy for board and management

7. Shipping cost analysis — Carrier-level cost breakdown (per-pound, collected vs paid) to identify margin improvement opportunities

YTD Performance & Outlook

| Metric | Q1 2026 | Q1 2025 | YoY |

|---|---|---|---|

| Revenue | $785,497 | $840,524 | -6.5% |

| Ad Spend | $169,116 | TBD | — |

The YTD gap is closing fast. January was -27% YoY, February was -32%, March was +14.2%. The trajectory has flipped decisively.

April outlook: Current run rate ($16.4K/day through April 12) projects ~$493K for the month — 24% above the $399K budget. If April holds, YTD revenue reaches ~$1.28M and likely pulls ahead of prior year by month-end.

Key questions for Q2:

  • Can we maintain $100K+ monthly ad spend at 4.85x+ MER, or does efficiency degrade as we push harder into peak season?
  • How quickly can Amazon scale beyond $30K/month — and at what point does it justify paid advertising on the platform?
  • Will the Menards opportunity convert to POs, and what does the inventory and fulfillment model look like at 300+ doors?
